name: Viking 1

parts.name: Lander body
parts.role: Hexagonal aluminum and titanium bonded structural frame

parts.name: Landing legs
parts.role: Three A-frame legs fitted with crushable honeycomb shock absorbers

parts.name: Sampler arm
parts.role: Retractable boom with backhoe scoop for soil collection
parts.snap: Surface sampler arm ready to trench.

parts.name: Dish antenna
parts.role: S-band high-gain parabolic antenna pointing directly to Earth

parts.name: Radioisotope power unit
parts.role: Two SNAP-19 RTGs providing continuous nuclear thermoelectric power

parts.name: Camera mast
parts.role: Twin facsimile scanning cameras and meteorology mast
parts.snap: Facsimile cameras calibrated for Mars panoramas.

challenge.title: Timed entry sequence
challenge.intro: Plunge through the Martian atmosphere. Trigger parachute deployment, release the heat shield, and ignite terminal thrusters at the exact altitude windows.
challenge.hint: Watch the altitude gauge: trigger each step when the indicator enters its highlighted target band.

signal_note: A faulty software command inadvertently pointed the antenna away from Earth in November 1982, ending 6 years of transmissions.
ending: Viking 1 gave humanity its first clear view of the red rocks and amber skies of Mars.
